name: application-15
title: CRM overview
description: A Pebblecrest CRM start page: three figures that count up once, accounts and contacts as one graph whose nodes glide between five layouts (cluster, rings, grid, orbit, radial), the agent's recent runs with a request that waits for Allow or Deny, a to-do list, a pipeline funnel that reshapes when the agent qualifies leads, the trend of new leads and the next 14 days, with sections that open from the sidebar, a sheet on phones. Plug your CRM into onTaskChange, onApprove and onDeny.
